title: [YSQL][randgen] Bitmap Scan plan crashes with EXC_BAD_ACCESS (code=1, address=0x0)     frame #0: 0x000000011003fcc7 postgres`datumCopy + 71 at .../src/postgres/src/backend/utils/adt/datum.c:139
body:
Jira Link: [DB-10987](https://yugabyte.atlassian.net/browse/DB-10987)
### Description

Problem
---
* The Bitmap Scan plan crashes persistently with `with EXC_BAD_ACCESS (code=1, address=0x0)     frame #0: 0x000000011003fcc7 postgres`datumCopy + 71 at .../src/postgres/src/backend/utils/adt/datum.c:139`.
* Reproducible on a recent master (42add04f18).

```
YB test# SET enable_seqscan = OFF;
SET
YB test#  SELECT table1  FROM (  SELECT * FROM CC  )  AS table1  WHERE col_varchar_key  <> (  SELECT col_varchar_key  FROM C  )  AND col_varchar_key  IN ( 'y' )  OR table1 .col_int_key  >  252  AND col_int_key  <  40   ;
server closed the connection unexpectedly
	This probably means the server terminated abnormally
	before or while processing the request.
The connection to the server was lost. Attempting reset: Succeeded.
psql (15.6 (Homebrew), server 11.2-YB-2.23.0.0-b0)
YB test# SET enable_seqscan = OFF;
SET
YB test# EXPLAIN (COSTS OFF) SELECT table1  FROM (  SELECT * FROM CC  )  AS table1  WHERE col_varchar_key  <> (  SELECT col_varchar_key  FROM C  )  AND col_varchar_key  IN ( 'y' )  OR table1 .col_int_key  >  252  AND col_int_key  <  40   ;
                                                                                                       QUERY PLAN
-------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------
 YB Bitmap Table Scan on cc
   Storage Filter: ((((col_varchar_key)::text <> ($0)::text) AND ((col_varchar_key)::text = 'y'::text)) OR ((col_int_key > 252) AND (col_int_key < 40)))
   InitPlan 1 (returns $0)
     ->  Index Only Scan using c_int_datetime_varchar_key on c
   ->  BitmapOr
         ->  Bitmap Index Scan on cc_int_datetime_varchar_key
               Index Cond: ((col_varchar_key)::text = 'y'::text)
               Storage Index Filter: (((col_varchar_key)::text <> ($0)::text) AND ((((col_varchar_key)::text <> ($0)::text) AND ((col_varchar_key)::text = 'y'::text)) OR ((col_int_key > 252) AND (col_int_key < 40))))
         ->  Bitmap Index Scan on cc_int_datetime_varchar_key
               Index Cond: ((col_int_key > 252) AND (col_int_key < 40))
(10 rows)

YB test#
```
